simple.meaning: תֹּכֶן (tôken) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a fixed quantity.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Exodus 5:18. The background is built from the passages where the word occurs.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to תֹּכֶן (H8506) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: תֹּכֶן (tôken) / H8506 is traced through Exodus 5:18, Ezekiel 45:11 with generated occurrence evidence.

firstOccurrence.englishText: Go therefore now, and work; for no straw shall be given to you; yet you shall deliver the same number of bricks!”

timeline.evidenceText: Go therefore now, and work; for no straw shall be given to you; yet you shall deliver the same number of bricks!”

The ephah and the bath shall be of one measure, that the bath may contain one tenth of a homer,‡ 1 homer is about 220 liters or 6 bushels and the ephah one tenth of a homer. Its measure shall be the same as the homer.
